ok.meaning: JSON is a refusal written to stderr. This stdin-stream stop execs a restricted read-only rsync sender on success; stdout is the rsync byte stream, not a receipt.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Native stderr refusal token. Stdin starts with a UTF-8 line beginning rsync --server --sender followed by a space. The line must end with LF within 30 seconds, be at most 4096 bytes before LF, and contain neither CR nor NUL. Sender-side source-file removal is forbidden.
